title: High-temperature oxidation kinetics of nanostructured thermoelectric skutterudite CoSb3 under different environments
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39219-39229
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08328H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
T. C. Anusree, Anuj A. Vargeese
Formation of CoSb3 is thermodynamically controlled by SbCl3 as the limiting reactant, and high-temperature oxidation kinetics of CoSb3 reveals sublimation of Sb and rapid conversion of initial oxides into stable oxides in air, compared to nitrogen.
